title.zh: 将布拉干省划分为六个（6）立法区的法案
title.en: An Act Reapportioning the Province of Bulacan Into Six (6) Legislative Districts
title.orig: An Act Reapportioning the Province of Bulacan Into Six (6) Legislative Districts

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2021/ra_11546_2021.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: All the incumbent Representatives of the Province of Bulacan shall continue to hold office until the expiration of their terms of office.
The Commission on Elections (COMELEC) shall issue the necessary rules and regulations to implement this Act.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) day after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
